Phase 2 asserts target/debug/mori exists after source6_expand passes, records quantity_hash in SOURCE6-BINARY-IDENTITY.json (role: no-default-features + source6-expansion CLI), and never conflates it with the Phase 1 binary. Phase 3 verifies target/debug/mori equals quantity_hash before launch, writes phase BINARY-IDENTITY.json, binds MORI_RUST_BIN to that path, and after Node exits verifies both that target/debug/mori still matches quantity_hash and that node-observations/run.json recorded the identical binarySha256.
assessments.boundedDiagnostics: Diagnostics remain strictly bounded to the original lightweight routine: cpu_sample is invoked at most 12 times at 10s intervals solely during the first 90s while child.poll() is None, bounded by min(sample_deadline, active_deadline), with no extension to 600s and no post-terminal or kill-grace sampling. Each sample records /proc/pressure/cpu and /proc/<pid>/stat ticks for processes verified to belong to active_sid. Both OWNED-CPU-PSI.json and DIAGNOSIS.md/OBSERVATIONS.json properly qualify that global PSI (98.30% some over 80.001s in quantity90) is not causal attribution to the owned session and matched (pid, startTimeTicks) tick deltas (3.02 CPU-seconds lower bound) omit first-seen, reaped, unsampled, and post-80s work.
assessments.deadlineAndCleanup: The worker is launched with start_new_session=True so active_sid equals child.pid and encompasses the timeout wrapper, worker, and all phase children. If time.monotonic() reaches active_deadline (began + 605s), the parent immediately sends SIGKILL to process group active_sid via os.killpg, performs a nonblocking child.poll(), writes CHILD-RESULT.json and OWNED-CPU-PSI.json, and raises TimeoutError in finally without removing the temporary root. On normal or pre-605s exit, owned_members(active_sid, active_deadline) checks /usr/bin/ps --sid for residual processes (with a <=0.25s bounded timeout), writes PROCESS-CLEANUP.json, kills any residual session members in finally, and removes the temporary root via shutil.rmtree(root) only when residual is empty and no cleanup_error occurred. In v2, worker() also writes phase RESULT.json with terminal exitCode, wallSeconds, and stdout/stderr SHA256 immediately after child.wait() before running post-phase verify_all/verify_configs so terminal facts survive any post-check failure.
